question: The independent border monitoring mechanism (IBMM) in Croatia, funded by the Commission, has not published any reports for the past two years. 1.
What is the Commission’s follow-up in monitoring the expenditure and funding of the Croatian IBMM?
Has the Commission received or requested any reports from the Croatian IBMM, and, if so, can it disclose the content of these reports?
If not, how is the Commission ensuring that the Croatian IBMM is independent, effective and transparent in the absence of any reporting?
answer: 1. The Independent Monitoring Mechanism (IMM) is part of the arrangements put in place to ensure the fulfilment of the horizontal enabling condition on compliance with the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights (HEC 3) of Croatia’s Border Management and Visa Instrument (BMVI) funding programme for the period 2021-2027, and is currently supported under the BMVI programme of Croatia. Croatia regularly reports to the Commission on the overall implementation of the programme, including on the IMM. 2.
IMM reports are made publicly available by its coordinating board. The next report is envisaged to be published soon.
3. The coordinating board ensures the IMM’s independence and manages its activities. It is composed of representatives of non-governmental organisations and academia.

The Commission only has an advisory role as member of the advisory board, which is linked to the IMM (but not forming part of it) and which provides oversight that further reinforces the IMM’s independence and provides recommendations for the enhancement of its functioning.

Its members, in addition to the Commission, are national ombudsmen, United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) Croatia, International Organisation for Migration (IOM) Croatia, the EU Agency for Fundamental Rights and Frontex’s Fundamental Rights Officer.

The Commission ensures — as member of the advisory board and when monitoring the management of EU funds — that the functioning and possible shortcomings in the IMM are duly assessed by the financial monitoring committee of the Croatian BMVI programme.
